description: A JWK Set without a keys member fails with InvalidKey; decided by ADR 0054 §4 precedence 1 (ADR 0041 §2): a set must have a keys array (RFC 7517 §5, MUST), so the import fails with InvalidKey before any selection; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
